# netbox_owner_groups (Data Source)

Retrieves all owner groups from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_owner_groups" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "owner_groups_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_owner_groups.example.owner_groups[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `owner_groups` (Attributes List) The owner groups found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner_groups))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--owner_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner_groups`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) A description of the owner groups.
- `id` (Number) The id of the owner groups.
- `member_count` (Number) The number of member objects that refer to the owner groups.
- `name` (String) The name of the owner groups.
